products.name: Relevance AI
products.note: No-code AI workforce; agent teams; task automation; APAC data residency

profile_text.body:
Relevance AI is a software company that provides a no-code platform for building and deploying AI agents across business functions. The company describes itself as enabling organizations to build specialist AI agents for sales, customer success, marketing, and human resources, with the platform designed to run what the company calls millions of daily tasks. Agent teams can be organized and operated together on a single platform, and the company notes support for APAC data residency.

The company's primary product, also called Relevance AI, is categorized as a coding and developer tool with a no-code orientation, allowing users to construct agent workflows without writing code. Rob Giglio is quoted on the company's site describing the platform as a way to find opportunities for AI to keep sellers and customer success representatives more engaged with customers.

The held facts include an active page on theworldofai.org but no recorded litigation, MCP server presence, SEC filings, or patent activity associated with the company at this time.
